name: chatbot-template
tagline: The canonical minimal AI chat UI starter from shadcn
description: chatbot-template is the official minimal chatbot starter from shadcn, wiring together Next.js, the AI SDK, and shadcn/ui on the Vercel AI Gateway. It is the canonical starting point for anyone who wants a clean, production-shaped AI chat interface without rebuilding the plumbing by hand. Because it comes from the shadcn team, the component quality and attention to detail are exactly what you would expect.
highlights: Official minimal chatbot template maintained by the shadcn team
Next.js + AI SDK + shadcn/ui wired on the Vercel AI Gateway
The canonical starter for polished AI chat UIs
Production-shaped structure you can extend instead of rebuild
curatorNote: When the shadcn team drops a chatbot template, it tends to become the default for everyone else's AI chat UI. Small but destined to be cloned thousands of times.
